svg.aria-label: Left: measured activation memory of one block on CPU grows linearly with sequence length for the fused attention kernel but bends upward for naive attention. Right: the Korthikanti formula for a 6.7B layer shows the same split, with the quadratic term dominating beyond a few thousand tokens
